overview: Global political developments include international diplomatic talks and leadership shifts across multiple countries. In commercial real estate, Starwood Property Trust reported a significant third-quarter loss, while other firms saw notable activity. San Francisco local news features new mayoral authority following recent elections and ongoing municipal developments. In Hawaii, Tyler Dos Santos-Tam was elected Honolulu Council Chair, and local legal proceedings involving county agencies continue to advance.

items.title: Ousted Paraguayan president appears before prosecutors
items.summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña was removed from office and placed under house arrest following a Senate impeachment vote.

items.title: Russian strikes wound nine and damage Ukraine's power network ahead of talks
items.summary: Russian strikes wounded nine people and damaged Ukraine's power network ahead of scheduled trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Bushburg in Contract to Buy 60 Wall Street at Jaw-Dropping Discount
items.summary: Bushburg Properties is in contract to purchase the 1.6 million-square-foot office tower at 60 Wall Street at a steep discount.

items.title: Starwood Property Trust Reports $390M Q3 Loss, but Sternlicht Remains Resolute
items.summary: Starwood Property Trust reported a $390 million loss in the third quarter of 2026 amid ongoing market pressures.

items.title: Mayor Daniel Lurie gains power — and loses excuses
items.summary: Voters have granted San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie increased power, leaving him with fewer excuses for bureaucratic delays.

items.title: Ripple Labs giving SFPD surveillance unit another 5 years of free rent, worth $5.5M
items.summary: Ripple Labs is providing the SFPD surveillance unit with another five years of free rent for its downtown sublease.

items.title: Tyler Dos Santos-Tam Elected Honolulu Council Chair
items.summary: Tyler Dos Santos-Tam, representing Chinatown, has been elected as the new Honolulu Council Chair.

items.title: Volunteer firefighter’s lawsuit against Hawaii County proceeds
items.summary: A lawsuit filed by a volunteer firefighter severely burned while fighting a brushfire in Kau is proceeding against Hawaii County.

wiki.title: Premise
wiki.extract: A premise is a proposition offered to support a conclusion. Premises are true or false statements that act as the starting points of arguments by presenting reasons to substantiate or refute assertions. Each argument is made up of a set of premises together with a conclusion. For example, the premises "all men are mortal" and "Socrates is a man" lead to the conclusion "Socrates is mortal." In ordinary language, premises can appear in the middle of a passage, often marked by indicator words, such as since and because. In formal logic, a common approach is to write each premise on a separate line, known as standard form.
